_comment: Where each bulk source lives, and how to find it again when the URL moves.
Publishers rotate these paths every release, so each entry carries a
discovery page and a link pattern: if `url` 404s, the builder scrapes the
page, takes the first matching link, and logs a RELOCATED warning. If that
fails too, the pack is skipped and the committed shards are left alone —
a rotted URL must never take the live site down with it.
